verdict.rationale: Docs reference an API in multiple places (external access token for Deployments API, JS file uploads, manual source map upload 'via our API', CSV/data export), and Raygun's own org publishes an MCP server enabling programmatic/AI-driven access, indicating some API surface exists. However, no dedicated public API reference or OpenAPI spec was found (openapi/swagger probes all 404, llms.txt 404), so there's no evidence of a comprehensive, well-documented public API a developer could fully drive the product through. Missing for 10: a discoverable API reference/OpenAPI spec, broader endpoint coverage beyond uploads/exports, and independent confirmation of API usability.
